title: Agribalyse 3.2 elementary flows → EF 3.1 characterization flow keys
description: Agribalyse 3.2 elementary flows onto EF 3.1 flow keys. Source fields are the names of the Agribalyse 3.2 SimaPro export: flow name, context [compartment] or [compartment, sub-compartment], unit. Lookup rule for a consumer: find the flow by name, context and unit in biosphere-1-brightway-flows; only if it has no entry there, by name alone in biosphere-2-curated. brightway_flows_review.json lists every exported flow without an entry in the first package, with the reason.

packages.title: Brightway Flows 1.1.0 links, one per flow, compartment and sub-compartment
packages.description: Links published in Brightway Flows 1.1.0 (Chris Mutel, Zenodo record 23554066, ODbL 1.0) from the elementary flows of the Agribalyse 3.2 export onto EF 3.1 flows listed in sentier-vocab. Broad matches, links onto flows EF 3.1 does not have, and unit changes without a published conversion are excluded. Of the 1,693 entries for which the SimaPro EF 3.1 method states a factor, 1,685 give the same factor on every method. Generated by sentier-importers (sources/brightway_flows).

packages.title: Name-level crosswalk from the Agribalyse adapter registry (fallback)
packages.description: Curated and reviewed name-level correspondences from the dds-agribalyse registry. Most entries carry a flow name only and a target name without an EF code. Holds no key the first package holds.
